apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added a desktop layout for Updates, with a grid of covers per day and chapters grouped by series (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a desktop layout for History, with a filter and right-click menu (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a desktop layout for Browse, with source and extension cards and a bar for each source's catalogue (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a desktop layout for Downloads, with selection and reordering in the server queue and On device side by side (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a desktop layout for Migrate, with sources and their series side by side and one migration window (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a settings window on desktop, with search and a page list (@aaronbamblett)
- Added an **Upcoming** calendar with **Week** and **Month** views and past releases (@aaronbamblett)
- Added custom covers with **Edit cover**, from your sources, AniList, MyAnimeList, Kitsu, MangaUpdates or an image link, shown on all your devices (@aaronbamblett)
- Added missing server settings, including **Sign-in**, **OPDS**, **Database**, **WebView** and the server image cache (@aaronbamblett)
- Added series notes and saved source searches, shared with the Suwayomi web interface (@aaronbamblett)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Changed migration to leave the series' own source out of the destinations (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed the desktop sidebar to show **Incognito** and **Settings** in place of **More** (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed the icons throughout the app and animated the main menu (@aaronbamblett)
- Reorganised settings and **More** into grouped pages, with a new **Sync** page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed server downloads to show series in your library, with the rest under **Not in your library** for accounts that manage users (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed Suggestions in the web version to use only AniList as other sources are blocked by the browser (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Made failed migrations show why and offer **Retry** (@aaronbamblett)
- Made **Migrate now**, **Copy now**, restores, data deletion and server-wide changes ask first (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a right-click menu that opens at the pointer on desktop pages, with the same actions on a long-press in History on phones (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a hand cursor and hover highlight to everything clickable on desktop and in the browser (@aaronbamblett)
- Made browser tabs show page names and support links opening in a new tab (@aaronbamblett)
- Made next chapter estimates follow each series' release schedule (@aaronbamblett)
- Made Suggestions show results without waiting for slow services and match series more accurately (@aaronbamblett)
- Made adding a single series from a source ask for categories and check for duplicates (@aaronbamblett)
- Made dark theme highlights easier to read (@aaronbamblett)
- Added sharing, saving and deleting covers from the full cover view (@aaronbamblett)
- Made the Linux AppImage update with AppImageUpdate, downloading only the changed parts (@aaronbamblett)
- Made registration codes show the permissions they grant (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Push progress to KOReader** and **Pull progress from KOReader** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added permissions when creating a user or a registration code (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Hide entries already in library** for browsing sources (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Duplicate chapters**, **Status** and **Source** library filters and **Open random entry** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **App language**, **Fuzzy search**, **Ignore filters when searching** and **Forget manga categories** settings (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Update all** for extensions (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a choice of what backups include (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Cancel all for this series** to the server download queue (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed a series being migrated onto itself and removed from the library (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed interrupted or overlapping migrations removing a series before its progress was copied (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed migration on desktop stretching covers, waiting forever on a source and showing no details for **Search manually** picks (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed covers not updating after a library update changed them on the server (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed server downloads staying stuck in the queue after a series was migrated or removed (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed changes to a series not showing straight away while viewing offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Test connection** in setup checking forever on an address it cannot read (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Outstanding codes** freezing the app on desktop and in the browser (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed account options showing on servers without user accounts (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed tracker icons not loading (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed tracker sign-in completing sign-ins you did not start (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed disabled text buttons looking pressable (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the phone menu bar ignoring dark themes (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the **More** page running into the bottom bar on phones (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed History opened from More having no back button on desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed setting descriptions being cut off (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Kisnov for the full Catalan translation, 無情天 for Chinese, JayDisastrue for French and Andrei Stepanov for Russian.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-x64.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
